# ui-badge

> Badge label for counts or status indicators with optional max truncation.

**Class:** `UIBadge`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `max` | `number` | When set, truncates numeric content to "max+" if exceeded |

## Usage

```html
<ui-badge></ui-badge>
```
